title: Times Minus 2? Vector x Scalar Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
Aarav cruises north at 6 m/s and his little cousin rides beside him at 3 m/s. Same direction, double the speed. So is Aarav's velocity just two times his cousin's? And what would minus two times mean? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 3, Motion in a Plane) we learn what a plain number does to a vector.

On a live motion notebook you turn a λ dial and watch the arrow stretch, shrink, collapse to the zero vector and flip, while the graph of |λA| draws a V shape. We write the rules step by step (|λA| = |λ||A|, the sign of λ sets the direction, -A = (-1)A, every component is multiplied), see why s = t v, F = m a and p = m v point the way they do, and reason link by link. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example, the exam trap about negative magnitudes, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.
